title: Indian-Style Yeast Bread
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Indian-style yeast bread that's perfect for snacking. This bread is made with quietly fermented yeast and has a soft, airy texture.

ingredients.name: quietly fermented yeast
ingredients.notes: Active dry yeast or instant yeast can be used as a substitute

instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine yeast and warm water. Let it sit for 5-7 minutes until yeast is activated.
2. Add flour, salt, and ghee or oil to the bowl. Mix until a dough forms.
3. Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
4. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1-2 hours until it doubles in size.
6. Punch down the dough and shape it into a round or oblong loaf.
7. Place the loaf on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
8. Bake the bread for 20-25 minutes until it's golden brown.
9. Remove the bread from the oven and let it cool on a wire rack for 10-15 minutes before slicing.
